data.content_ref: inline:Replace Boolean attack with bounded integer weights and define the grounded labeling as the least fixed point of a monotone operator on a finite lattice of (label, weight) pairs, with threshold τ controlling acceptance. Since the lattice is finite and the operator is monotone, the least fixed point is unique and reachable in polynomially many iterations; reinstatement becomes the derived property that a node defended by a chain of sufficiently strong counter-attacks crosses τ. The map from τ to labels is itself monotone, enabling sensitivity analysis without recomputation. Commit only roots whose IN-status is stable under small τ perturbation, preserving committed-root validity.
